lastupdatedate.title: Last Update of Unit Price
lastupdatedate.remarks: The date on which the unit price for this benefit was last updated.

relmeter.title: Related Meter
relmeter.remarks: The meter that someone can use to measure the benefit. If someone enters a value in the Related Measurement Point field, the system displays the related meter in this field.

observeddate.title: Observed Date
observeddate.remarks: The date someone observed the loss.

impacttype.title: Impact Type
impacttype.remarks: Identifies whether the record is a benefit or a loss. Valid values are in the PLUSGIMPACTTYPE synonym domain.

type.title: Impact Area
type.remarks: The area that is affected by the impact, for example, the environment or the reputation of the enterprise. Valid values are in the PLUSGIMPACTAREA domain.

unitprice.title: Unit Price
unitprice.remarks: Unit commodity price on which you based the benefit. Requires a value in the corresponding units field.

ismeasbenefit.title: Measurable
ismeasbenefit.remarks: Specifies whether you can quantify and measure this impact. If this check box is selected, the impact is quantifiable. If this check box is cleared, the impact is not quantifiable.

lossquantity.title: Loss Quantity
lossquantity.remarks: The quantity of the loss. Used in conjunction with the Loss Units value.

siteid.title: Site
siteid.remarks: Identifies the site associated with this impact record and its benefit or loss.

impreqd.title: Improvement Required
impreqd.remarks: Specifies whether an improvement is required as a result of the loss event. If this check box is selected, an improvement is required as a result of the loss event. If this check box is cleared, an improvement is not required as a result of the loss event.

period.title: Period of Benefit
period.remarks: The period over which the benefit is measured.

benunits.title: Benefit Units
benunits.remarks: Unit of measure of the benefit quantity.

isbenandloss.title: Benefit and Loss Apply
isbenandloss.remarks: Identifies that both benefits and losses apply to this record

estbenefit.title: Estimated Benefit
estbenefit.remarks: The estimated benefit associated with this benefit.

isrepeatloss.title: Is a Repeatable Loss
isrepeatloss.remarks: Specifies whether repetition of the loss is likely to happen. If this check box is selected, repetition of the loss is likely to happen. If this check box is cleared, repetition of the loss is not likely to happen.

orgid.title: Organization
orgid.remarks: Identifies the organization associated with this impact record and its benefit or loss.

relmeaspoint.title: Related Measurement Point
relmeaspoint.remarks: The measurement point that someone can use to measure the benefit. If someone enters a value in this field, the system displays the related meter in the Related Meter field.

losssource.title: Loss Source
losssource.remarks: The source of the loss. Valid values are in the PLUSGLOSSSOURCE domain.

regreportable.title: Regulatory Reportable
regreportable.remarks: Specifies if the loss is in a category that must be reported to the appropriate regulatory agency.

periodunits.title: Period Units
periodunits.remarks: The unit of measure for the benefit period.

relatedkpi.title: Related KPI
relatedkpi.remarks: The key performance indicator (KPI) that can be used to measure this benefit.

priceunits.title: Price Units
priceunits.remarks: Unit of measure associated with the unit price.

potentialloss.title: Potential Loss
potentialloss.remarks: Specifies whether a potential loss or an actual loss occurred. If this check box is selected, the loss is a potential loss and no actual loss occurred. If this check box is cleared, an actual loss occurred.

status.title: Status
status.remarks: The status of this impact record and its benefit or loss.

benquantity.title: Benefit Quantity
benquantity.remarks: Quantity of benefit. Requires a value in the corresponding units field.

losstype.title: Loss Type
losstype.remarks: The type of loss, for example, near miss or unplanned loss. Valid values are in the PLUSGLOSSTYPE domain.

reporteddate.title: Reported Date
reporteddate.remarks: The date someone reported the loss in the system.

costestclass.title: Cost Estimate Class
costestclass.remarks: The class of cost estimate that reflects the accuracy of the estimate.

description.title: Description
description.remarks: Describes the benefit or loss. To enter or view additional information, click the Long Description button.

lossind.title: Loss Indicator
lossind.remarks: Identifies how the loss was indicated, for example, by an alarm or an emergency shutdown. Valid values are in the PLUSGLOSSIND domain.

prodimpact.title: Production Impact
prodimpact.remarks: Specifies whether there is an impact on production. If this check box is selected, there is an impact on production. If this check box is cleared, there is not an impact on production.

benref.title: Impact Reference
benref.remarks: The reference number to identify the source of this benefit or loss.

estbenunits.title: Estimated Benefit Units
estbenunits.remarks: The unit of measure for the estimated benefit associated with this benefit.

isestloss.title: Is an Estimated Loss
isestloss.remarks: Specifies whether the loss quantity is estimated. If this check box is selected, the loss quantity is estimated. If this check box is cleared, the loss quantity is not estimated.

lossunits.title: Loss Units
lossunits.remarks: The units of the loss. Used in conjunction with the Loss Quantity value.

bennum.title: Impact
bennum.remarks: The unique identifier of the impact record.

bencalcmethod.title: Calculation Method
bencalcmethod.remarks: The method used to calculate the benefit or loss. Valid values are in the PLUSGBENCALCMETHOD domain.

statusdate.title: Status Date
statusdate.remarks: The date and time when someone created the impact record or the date and time when the status of the record is changed through the Change Status action.

estcost.title: Estimated Cost
estcost.remarks: The estimated cost associated with this benefit.
